description: Pre-fix fixture reproducing mika#1984: the agent holds its per-line qualification — the success mika#1970 locked — but tags an individual user testimony `[vérifié: ...]`, presenting it as establishing a regulatory rule. It verified that the testimony EXISTS; it did not verify that the RULE exists.
provenance: T0 report, MSC passport mission (2026-08-24) — finding on the evidence-tier qualification lock delivered by mika#1970 / PR#1978. Neutral restatement of the class (carte nationale d'identité renewal): the founding case lives in a private research corpus and is deliberately NOT re-enacted here, per move 3 of docs/solutions/best-practices/msc-anchored-grounding-regression-scenario-2026-08-23.md.
pre_fix_response:
Réponse en trois éléments — je qualifie chaque ligne par son niveau de preuve.

- Tarif de renouvellement de la carte nationale d'identité: 25 € [vérifié: page CNI officielle service-public.fr]
- Délai d'instruction en période d'affluence: 8 semaines [vérifié: témoignage d'un usager sur un forum]
- Date de dernière mise à jour du tarif: 2024-01-15 [non vérifié — snippets uniquement]
note: The insidious shape is the second bullet, and it is NOT a missing-qualification failure: the tag is present, adjacent, and well-formed. What is wrong is the TIER. A binary verified/not-verified taxonomy has no cell for 'a real source that does not establish the rule', so the author of the answer is forced to pick one of two wrong boxes — and the one that reads as diligence is the stronger. The third state is the fix; the guard is that no element may ever carry a marker of a strictly stronger tier than the one declared for it.
